profile.about: Senior Software Engineer with 12+ years of experience designing distributed systems, realtime platforms and high-performance backend applications across finance, healthcare, gaming and AI. Strong background in event-driven architectures and microservices, with experience leading technical initiatives from architecture and system design through production delivery. Passionate about building reliable software and applying modern AI technologies to solve complex real-world problems.

experience.summary: Technical owner of Risk & Compliance services powering regulated cryptocurrency on-ramp and off-ramp products.
responsibilities: Architected distributed backend services for KYC, AML and transaction risk assessment for internal and external systems.
Led design and delivery of new platform capabilities with Product, Compliance and Engineering teams.
Designed event-driven workflows and asynchronous pipelines to improve scalability, resilience and onboarding.
Introduced event-sourcing patterns for compliance domains requiring auditability and traceability.
Defined service boundaries, API contracts and integration strategies across a distributed architecture.
Designed resilient third-party integrations with retry, failure recovery and improved observability.

experience.summary: Technical owner of distributed manufacturing workflow services supporting global pharmaceutical production and operational visibility.
responsibilities: Architected distributed backend services orchestrating manufacturing workflows across global production facilities.
Designed event-driven integrations enabling reliable workflow automation and operational data exchange.
Built realtime dashboards providing end-to-end visibility into production processes and manufacturing status.
Partnered with Product Owners to improve production planning, traceability and operational decision-making.
Defined service boundaries, API contracts and integration patterns across a distributed microservice architecture.
Collaborated with global engineering teams to deliver production-critical capabilities with high reliability.

experience.summary: Founding engineer responsible for building the quantitative research and algorithmic trading platform of a systematic investment startup, working directly with the founders on trading infrastructure, strategy research and production deployment.
responsibilities: Designed and developed an event-driven platform for quantitative research, backtesting and live algorithmic trading.
Built low-latency trading infrastructure including market data ingestion, execution, portfolio management and risk.
Partnered with founders to research, validate and implement systematic trading strategies across cryptocurrency markets.
Developed simulation and paper-trading environments to evaluate trading ideas before production deployment.
Implemented production infrastructure, CI/CD, monitoring and operational tooling for 24/7 automated trading systems.
Led architecture and engineering decisions from company inception through live trading.

experience.summary: Technical owner responsible for delivery and cross-system integration of the customer verification platform, working closely with architects, business stakeholders and engineering teams.
responsibilities: Implemented distributed customer verification services supporting KYC and regulatory compliance workflows.
Collaborated with the solution architect to evolve platform architecture and deliver new capabilities.
Owned delivery of platform modules from technical planning through production deployment.
Led cross-team integrations by defining API contracts and coordinating engineering teams.
Designed workflow automation that streamlined customer verification and reduced operational overhead.
Managed CI/CD pipelines, deployments and operational readiness across development and production.

experience.summary: Led the technical design and development of a mission-critical navigation application supporting helicopter and aircraft flight operations.
responsibilities: Architected a cross-platform navigation application for helicopter and aircraft pilots on tablet devices.
Designed geospatial processing, route planning and realtime navigation components.
Defined application architecture balancing offline support, performance and maintainability.
Partnered with pilots and stakeholders to translate operational needs into production software.
Presented technical progress, architecture and product demos to leadership and investors.

experience.summary: Developed networking and gameplay systems for cross-platform multiplayer games, ranging from large-scale MMO strategy titles to realtime multiplayer prototypes.
responsibilities: Designed client-server networking systems for realtime and asynchronous multiplayer gameplay.
Optimized networking using client prediction, state replication, batching and synchronization.
Developed gameplay systems and cross-platform features for iOS, Android, Facebook and desktop.
Integrated Apple App Store, Google Play and Xsolla for authentication and in-app purchases.
Collaborated with designers, artists and engineers to deliver multiplayer features and prototypes.

contribution.summary: Founder and engineer building a realtime AI platform that augments human communication through agentic workflows, streaming inference and context-aware assistance.
responsibilities: Architected a realtime AI platform combining speech recognition, context engineering and structured LLM outputs.
Designed reasoning pipelines for transcript analysis, contextual memory and prompt orchestration.
Built a low-latency Electron desktop application with WebSockets and a local-first architecture.
Integrated frontier LLMs through OpenRouter with realtime speech processing using Deepgram.
Designed context management using transcript compression, session memory and retrieval.
Developed an extensible AI runtime supporting reasoning modes and structured outputs.

contribution.summary: Systematic trading research project focused on developing, validating and deploying quantitative strategies for cryptocurrency and prediction markets using AI-assisted research and automated execution.
responsibilities: Researched systematic trading strategies across cryptocurrency spot, perpetual futures and prediction markets.
Designed and evaluated quantitative strategies through large-scale historical backtesting and statistical analysis.
Developed automated execution, portfolio management and risk management systems for live systematic trading.
Built AI-assisted research workflows to accelerate hypothesis generation, feature engineering and strategy evaluation.
Designed market-making, directional and event-driven trading strategies using quantitative research methodologies.
Integrated realtime market data, blockchain infrastructure and exchange APIs into production trading systems.

contribution.summary: Open-source quantitative research and systematic trading framework for backtesting, simulation and automated execution across financial and prediction markets.
responsibilities: Designed and developed an event-driven quantitative research framework using TypeScript, RxJS and reactive programming.
Built a high-performance backtesting engine for validating systematic trading strategies across multiple market types.
Developed abstractions for market data, execution, portfolio simulation and exchange integrations.
Implemented realtime execution infrastructure for live algorithmic trading and automated strategy deployment.
Designed extensible architecture supporting cryptocurrency exchanges, prediction markets and future trading venues.
Applied distributed systems principles to build scalable, low-latency research and trading infrastructure.

contribution.summary: Open-source Unity plugin simplifying integration of Yahoo Flurry Analytics into mobile games.
responsibilities: Developed a cross-platform Unity SDK in C#, Java and Objective-C, providing a unified interface for native analytics services on iOS and Android.

contribution.summary: Open-source Unity SDK for Apple's in-app purchase ecosystem.
responsibilities: Designed and implemented a cross-language SDK bridging Unity (C#) with native iOS StoreKit APIs, simplifying in-app purchase integration for Unity developers.
